notes: Create-a-class perks: one per player. sim.js reads the numeric fields; the lobby shows name/desc/icon.
Effect fields (all optional): respawnMult, extraGrenades, sprintMult, explosiveDamageMult, reloadMult, uavImmune, revealBonusSec.
demoAllowed: selectable in the free web demo; the rest are $4.99 Full Game.

speakToTheManager.name: Speak to the Manager
speakToTheManager.desc: Respawn 40% faster. Someone is going to hear about this.

cardioMom.name: Cardio Mom
cardioMom.desc: +12% sprint speed. 5 a.m. spin class pays off.

secondHelping.name: Second Helping
secondHelping.desc: +1 Lawsuit. You always bring extra to the potluck.

thickSkinned.name: Thick-Skinned
thickSkinned.desc: Take 30% less explosive damage. Twelve years on the board will do that.

quickPaperwork.name: Quick Paperwork
quickPaperwork.desc: Reload 30% faster. Pre-filled forms, in triplicate.

offTheGrid.name: Off the Grid
offTheGrid.desc: Enemy Ring Doorbell sweeps can't see you. You disabled the Wi-Fi.

nosyNeighbor.name: Nosy Neighbor
nosyNeighbor.desc: Enemies who fire stay on your radar 3 s longer. You were watching anyway.
